 POST-GAME COVERAGE
 Game-changing highlights from the matchup between the New Jersey Devils and the Washington Capitals
 Take a look inside the Devils dressing room following a 7-4 win over the Washington Capitals.
 PHOTO GALLERY
 +5 
 Devils at Capitals
 Photos from the game between the Devils and Capitals. Photos by Getty Images.
 GOALS & HIGHLIGHTS
 FIRST PERIOD
 WSH 1, NJD 0: Pierre-Luc Dubois opens the scoring for the Capitals on a close-in opportunity.
 NJD 1, WSH 1: Lenni Hameenaho scores his second goal in as many games to get the Devils even.
 WSH 2, NJD 1: Ryan Leonard blasted a one-timer from the top of the right circle to put the Caps back in front by one.
 NJD 2, WSH 2: Connor Brown looked to have netted a power play goal to pull the Devils back on even terms but the play was reviewed to see if it was kicked in. After review, it was ruled a goal!
 WSH 3, NJD 2: With 1:20 to go in the opening period, Washington scored on a wild scramble in front as Anthony Beauvillier put the puck into the open net with Hellebuyck down and out.
 SECOND PERIOD
 NJD 3, WSH 3: Jesper Boqvist picked up a Hameenaho rebound in front and put it in to get the Devils back on even terms once again.
 NJD 4, WSH 3: Devils take their first lead of the game as Timo Meier puts the puck in on the doorstep.
 THIRD PERIOD
 NJD 5, WSH 3: Devils scored a shorthanded goal as Nico Hischier's shot went in and out of the net so fast that the play continued and they had to review it later.
 NJD 5, WSH 4: Capitals get one back 26 seconds later, still on the power play as Ilya Protas scored.
 NJD 6, WSH 4: Evan Rodrigues scores off the side boards, going off the defender in front.
 NJD 7, WSH 4 : Rodrigues adds an empty-net goal to put the Devils up by three with 3:15 to play.
